Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern 6 Globe Flush Mount Metal Ceiling Pendant Chandelier Fixture - 26 x 26 x 8 Inches, Matte Black
Colors: Matte Black
Materials: Metal
Bathe your interiors in light with this large, multifaceted pendant. The 6 matte-black metal branches hold up 6 spherical lights with white glass shades that emit warm light in all directions. 26"W x 26"D x 8"H Matte-black metal; white glass shade 6 glass shades Type A, bulb not included Professional installation recommended For indoor use only
